items.title: Reconcile this backlog with current source and active work
items.problem: Plans and implementation evidence are spread across files; the captured source can change while other tasks work.
scope: Existing roadmap, execution status, open issues and pull requests (read-only)
acceptance: Classify each candidate as implemented, still open, superseded or awaiting evidence; retain source links and reasons.
Inspect dirty state, remotes, worktrees and local environment presence without reading secrets; avoid duplicate work with active owners.
Resolve the actual offline validation commands and record exact current default-branch/working-tree provenance; do not copy historical live passes to newer code.
validation: git status --short
git remote -v
git worktree list --porcelain
Read the applicable instructions and validation workflow; read gh issue list and gh pr list for the named repository using nathanmcnulty. Do not create or modify issues/PRs.

items.title: Complete exact-candidate Windows 11 human acceptance
items.problem: The active continuation retains release no-go for clean-profile sign-in, visual wizard and lifecycle gates.
acceptance: Use the exact current signed source and installed executable hashes in a normal standard-user Windows 11 desktop.
Record browser/WAM identity, unavailable-target rejection, visual wizard, cancel/recovery, draft reopening and secret-marker checks.
Update each gate with current evidence; historical Sandbox/CLI proofs do not become current GUI passes.
validation: Follow section A of docs/EXECUTION-CONTINUATION-20260927.md with the maintainer in the prepared full desktop.
Separate read-only visual/auth checks from the separately authorized deploy/verify/down lifecycle and cleanup.
Run npm run verify only for affected code; it is not human acceptance.

items.title: Design explicit provider account transitions after the multi-account trial
items.problem: The first two account-choice packets are merged; reconnect/selection should follow observed Windows provider limitations.
acceptance: Use the real multi-account trial to choose bounded explicit reconnect paths for each provider.
Changing identity/target invalidates readiness and permission proof; no parsing token caches or silent CLI defaults.
Tests prove wrong account, unavailable target, expiry and cancellation remain fail-closed; human trial remains separate.
validation: npm run verify
Review the current Windows gate evidence and account-selection design before proposing account-transition code.

items.title: Improve optional-feature recommendations using proven permissions and receipt state
items.problem: The wizard should connect optional feature benefit with exact incremental permissions and actual deployment evidence.
acceptance: Show per-feature permission deltas and missing requirement gaps without treating catalog metadata as authorization.
Disabled features remain optional and display-only source data stays inert.
Candidate receipt evidence remains bound to source/target and never implies human-visible endpoint success.
validation: npm run verify
Use fixtures for absent/unavailable permissions, changed source revision and stale receipts.

items.title: Prepare the exact-candidate release checkpoint
items.problem: Private signing and hosted tests do not authorize a public beta release.
acceptance: All required current-candidate gates and any explicitly accepted exceptions are recorded.
Separately authorize tag/draft/publication and verify downloaded assets plus installed payload.
Create a new signed candidate only when application/packaging/workflow changes require it; preserve historical invalid-upgrade evidence.
validation: Use the offline commands in the registered validation workflow; record the exact commands, revision and results before implementation is complete.
After separate authorization, retain redacted exact-target live evidence and cleanup results outside public Git. Do not execute live operations from this backlog alone.
